entries.zh: 感戴恩德；为所受恩惠（好处）致谢。
entries.en: to give thanks for a kindness or benefit received; to feel grateful for favors.

entries.zh: 感激；道谢、致谢（原文“格”系“激”之音近写法）。
entries.en: to be grateful; to give thanks.
entries.notes: H“感格”当为“感激”之音借（M queg、R que 均为“激/格”同音），四栏互证致谢义清晰。

entries.zh: 多承；承蒙费心、多谢（客套谢语）。
entries.en: much obliged; thanks for your trouble (polite formula).

entries.zh: 多感；多多感谢、深感厚意。
entries.en: many thanks; deeply obliged.

entries.zh: 多蒙；承蒙关照、多蒙恩待。
entries.en: much obliged; much indebted (to your favor).

entries.zh: 多感；多多感谢、深感厚意（与第 4 条同词重出）。
entries.en: many thanks; deeply obliged.

entries.zh: 谢愿；还愿谢恩——所许之愿得偿而向神明致谢。
entries.en: to give thanks in fulfillment of a vow; to thank (God/the gods) for a granted petition.
entries.notes: L、R 两栏残缺；L“cumpliendo el boſto”应读作“cumpliendo el voto”（还愿），与 H“謝愿”、M ſia guan 相证。

entries.zh: 感恩；感戴恩惠、心怀感激。
entries.en: to feel gratitude; to give thanks for kindness received.
entries.notes: R 栏残损（末音节 T99）且与 H/M 不对应；依 H“感恩”、M cam ĩ 立义。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: [damaged in source; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: L/H/R 三栏残缺、M 含 T99，仅可辨“感恩”起首，整条语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 拜谢；行礼拜谢、躬身致谢。
entries.en: to thank with a bow; to give thanks humbling or prostrating oneself.

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: [damaged in source; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: H“九割”与 L“palabra impropias”（不当言词）对不上，R 残文无法对音；语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 一步一步；逐次少量给予、渐渐给（西文 poco a poco）。
entries.en: to give little by little; step by step, gradually.
entries.notes: H“步寸”带[疑]标记且字数与 M/R 三音节不合；据 R（步步進）与 L“poco a poco”立为逐次渐进给予。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: [damaged in source; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: L 残文“eſme caße”不可解，M 大面积污损（T99×3）且残缺，H 三字均带异写之疑；仅 M/R 可辨“克己使(人)信”一类音节，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 禀上司；向上司禀报所作之事（首字原作“掩”，据文义当为“稟”）。
entries.en: to report to one's superior; to give account to a superior of what one has done.
entries.notes: H 首字[疑:掩/稟]，依 L“dar cuenta a el ſuperior”当作“稟上司”；M 之 chio ſy 即“上司”。

entries.zh: 见赐几粒；见面赏给几粒（粒状之物，或指丸药）。
entries.en: to bestow a few grains or pills (on meeting); to give a few (grains).
entries.notes: L 残文“sonposos”不可确解、R 残缺；据 H“見賜幾粒”与 M 末音节（疑 ſiap/liap＝粒）立义。

entries.zh: 分汝；分给汝、给与你（“分”为闽南语“给”义动词）。
entries.en: to give (it) to you; to hand something to you.
entries.notes: L 残文“Dar, Datter par te.”费解（或为 dar de parte 之类讹写）、R 残缺；据 H 分汝、M pun lu 立义。

entries.zh: 写字／呈字；写字或向师长呈上字纸（首字“呈/寫”两读并存）。
entries.en: to write characters; to submit one's writing (to the master).
entries.notes: H 首字[疑:呈/寫]（M 作 ſia＝寫，R 作 cheng＝呈，两读并存），L 残文不可确解；姑立为呈/写字义。

entries.zh: 欢喜；喜悦、高兴。
entries.en: to rejoice; to be glad.
entries.notes: L 残文“Abrois”未获确解；据 H 歡喜、M hua hy、R huan hy 立义。

entries.zh: 恭喜；祝贺、道贺。
entries.en: to congratulate; to offer congratulations (parabién).

entries.zh: 犯人疑；对犯案之人起疑、疑其有罪。
entries.en: to suspect a person (of wrongdoing); to be in doubt about someone's guilt.
entries.notes: M 栏残缺且末音节无调号（T00）；“犯人疑”句法费解，按 R 逐字对音立义。

entries.zh: 赏钱；赏给钱银、打赏。
entries.en: to give reward money; to tip or bestow money.
entries.notes: L“Gapans”未获确解、M 末音节残损（T99）；据 H 賞錢、R ſiang chien 立义。

entries.zh: 涉疑；涉嫌、被牵涉嫌疑。
entries.en: to be implicated; to fall under suspicion.
entries.notes: H 首字[疑:涉/沙]，M ſiap 支持作“涉”；R 残缺。

entries.zh: 递书；双手捧函、屈膝呈递书信。
entries.en: to hand over a letter (with both hands, kneeling); to present a letter.
entries.notes: H 首字[疑:遞/迺]，M Tey/R ty 支持“遞”；西文所记为跪呈书信之礼。

entries.zh: 且喜；为之欢喜、闻喜讯而欣然。
entries.en: to be glad at (good) news; to rejoice.
entries.notes: H 首字[疑:且/旦]，M chia/R che 与“且”相合；西文为“予她喜讯”（darla alegre nuevas）。
